entries.description: Read-only WebMCP tools registered in the browser on allisons.dev (document.modelContext.registerTool) for exploring Allison Coleman's projects and writing, plus a declaratively annotated contact form. They only exist in a browser with WebMCP enabled; there is no server endpoint.
representativeQueries: How do I contact Allison Coleman?
List Allison's blog posts about agents

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search published projects by keyword and optional group.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get one project's summary and links by slug.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: List published blog posts, newest first.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Open a same-site page in the current tab.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Email link, GitHub, LinkedIn and X.
